name: severity-classify
description: Calibration harness orchestration: routes an incident through judge-severity and emits the CHOSEN severity as its output (each branch is a code node returning its own name). That makes the judge eval-able — an eval with an `exact` scorer measures the judge's ROUTING ACCURACY against labeled incidents. Pair with datasets/severity-calibration.json + evals/severity-calibration.json. This is the pattern for calibrating any router/judge: wrap it so the output IS the decision.
